+from pathlib import Path

+from PIL import Image

+

+def observe(seconds=0, video='none'):
+    global obs
+    obs = robot.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video=video)

+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'latest_{cam}.png')
+    print('OBS META', json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2))
+    print('PROPRIO', obs.meta.get('proprio'))

+def ee(points, note=''):
+    """Submit a list of fingertip-centre [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz,gripper] poses."""

+    res = robot.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float32), video='both', note=note)
+    print('RESULT', json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, frame in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(frame).save(OUT / f'latest_{cam}.png')
+    obs = res
+    return res
+
+def joints(points, dt=.2, note=''):
+    """Submit [joint1..joint7, gripper] targets."""
